paper_title: Online Coloring for Graphs of Large Odd Girth
statement: ▶ Conjecture 25. For some constant c ≥ 1, there exists an online coloring algorithm that achieves O(nc/g ) colors for graphs with constant odd girth g.
context: However, in terms of the speed of convergence, our exponent is approximately log2 g , 5 1 which is much slower than the exponent g−3 in the lower bound. Therefore, it is natural to ask whether the following conjecture holds. ▶ Conjecture 25. For some constant c ≥ 1, there exists an online coloring algorithm that achieves O(nc/g ) colors for graphs with constant odd girth g.
